project.name: project_hype
project.description: Live speculative foreign currency intelligence dashboard — real-time hype scoring, NLP catalyst analysis, commodity signal integration, ROI modeling, and catalyst spike alerts for 40 exotic and undervalued currencies.

checklist.title: Auth enforced server-side on every non-public route
evidence: 7 unauthenticated routes triaged as public by design
9 GET routes have no visible auth; confirm each is meant to be public

checklist.title: Every object lookup scoped to the caller (no IDOR)
Admin and role checks on the server
No mass assignment (request body never spread into the DB)
No secrets in the frontend bundle
evidence: No secret-looking public env vars or client-side secrets found.

checklist.title: No secrets committed to the repository
evidence: None in the current files. Git history isn't scanned: run `npx gitleaks detect --log-opts="--all"` once.

checklist.title: .env gitignored, .env.example present, gitleaks pre-commit hook
checklist.fix: Add `.env*` (with `!.env.example`) to .gitignore and a gitleaks hook via pre-commit or husky.

checklist.title: Paid AI APIs behind spend caps
evidence: uses anthropic: set a monthly cap in that provider's billing settings

checklist.title: Prices set server-side; access granted only from a verified Stripe webhook
Real auth provider, no homemade password or session handling
Short-lived access tokens; refresh tokens revoked on logout
Rate limits on auth, email sends, and AI endpoints
Schema validation on every route, unknown fields rejected
evidence: Unknown fields are accepted silently (no .strict() / extra='forbid').
checklist.fix: Use .strict() on Zod request schemas, or model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid') on Pydantic models.

checklist.title: SSRF: user-supplied URLs can't reach private or metadata IPs
evidence: No server-side fetch of a user-supplied URL found.

checklist.title: Model input untrusted; agent tools constrained
evidence: AI code present (anthropic); review tool permissions and prompt-injection paths.

checklist.title: Production credentials not reachable by agents or dev tooling
evidence: Keep prod keys out of local .env files and agent-accessible shells.

checklist.title: Storage private; files via signed URLs; uploads not served from the app origin
evidence: No file storage or upload libraries detected.

checklist.title: No dangerouslySetInnerHTML / unsanitized HTML on user or model output
CSRF protection if auth uses cookies
No stack traces or err.message returned on 5xx in production
evidence: Needs code review of the error handler.

checklist.title: No public source maps, debug routes, Swagger or GraphQL introspection in prod
evidence: No debug flags or API explorers found.

checklist.title: Preview/staging don't share the prod DB or prod secrets
evidence: Check your hosting dashboard's per-environment variables.

checklist.title: Lockfile committed; CI installs with --frozen-lockfile
Dependency scanning (Dependabot, Renovate, or an audit step)
Every dependency real, maintained, correctly named
evidence: 41 dependencies. Run `lens security --osv` for known CVEs; typo-squats need review.

checklist.title: CLAUDE.md, skills and MCP configs reviewed for commands and secrets
Security headers and CSP
CORS is an explicit allowlist on credentialed routes
evidence: No wildcard or reflected CORS origins found.

checklist.title: No $queryRawUnsafe / string-built SQL
Row-level security if clients talk to the DB directly
Logs redact auth headers, cookies, tokens, passwords, PII
Audit log for logins, permission changes, deletes, exports, payments
Backups configured with a documented restore procedure
evidence: Check your database host's backup settings and write down the restore steps.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: Public by design (no user accounts). Double opt-in: stores nothing until the emailed token is redeemed; 5/min rate limit, per-address cooldown, gated by ALERTS_ENABLED.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: Authorised by the emailed confirmation token (hashed, single-use, regex-validated) rather than a session. 10/min rate limit.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: Authorised by the subscriber's emailed unsubscribe token; same response whether or not it matches, so no oracle. 10/min rate limit.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe target; must accept unauthenticated POSTs from mail providers. Token-gated, 30/min rate limit.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: First-party analytics beacon, not a webhook. Anonymous by design; 120/min rate limit, event name truncated, props sanitised and size-capped, always 204.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: Anonymous share links by design. Positions validated (tracked codes, finite bounded amounts, max 50), 10/min rate limit, share URL built from server-side APP_URL.

findings.title: State-changing endpoint without visible auth
findings.triageNote: Stateless calculation: POST only carries the request body; nothing is written. Inputs validated and bounded, 30/min rate limit.
